messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: Dedicated-resv-pool-alpha GPU utilization 100% (90/90 GPUs). Queue length for reserved tenants rising: 1.2k pending requests. Autoscaler event: scale_attempt_failed - reached max_replicas=10. Impact: elevated latency and 503s for some reserved tenants. Paging oncall.
oncall-nyc: I’m on it — acknowledging page. @sre-amber can you pick this up? I’m pulling logs.
sre-amber: oncall-nyc thanks — looking. Quick notes: metrics show sustained enqueue rate spike from tenant:EnterpriseZ + a bunch of best-effort batch jobs from infra-snapshot. Suspect noisy neighbor + autoscale ceiling.
platform-jay: I see the autoscaler config for pool-alpha has max_replicas: 10 (safety cap for cost control). Nodepool quota also at limit in us-west1. We could bump to 15 but need approval. Any immediate mitigations first?
eng-runtime-maya: We can enable preemptive eviction of low-priority best-effort jobs in pool-alpha to free ~16 GPUs within 90s. I can trigger the eviction script. It’s safe for those jobs (retries enabled).
sre-amber: Good. Run eviction now. Also shift reserved tenant routing for EnterpriseZ to fallback model small-run in hosted for heavy requests to avoid 503s while we free capacity.
oncall-nyc: @eng-runtime-maya please run eviction and @platform-jay prep the increase. I’ll message support.
eng-runtime-maya: running eviction: ```/opt/tools/evict-low-priority --pool=alpha --target-gpus=16 --grace=30``` Logs: ```evict: selected 12 batch jobs + 4 snapshot jobs -> freed 16 GPUs
pods terminated: snapshot-ops-12, batch-cleanup-87, batch-ml-09 ...
freed_gpus: 16
```
incident-bot: Autoscaler event: capacity_freed: +16 GPUs detected, available_gpus now 16. Queue length dropping from 1200 -> 420 over 90s.
platform-jay: Nodepool quota still at cloud-project limit; raised request to cloudbilling for quota bump (ticket #CB-8892). In parallel I can temporarily increase autoscaler max_replicas to 14 for pool-alpha — requires lead approval. @product-raj are you OK with temporary cost delta?
product-raj: approve temporary bump to 14 for 4 hours to stabilize customers. Track cost and revert. Make sure we have rollback plan.
sre-amber: I’ll coordinate: step1 eviction done. step2 bump autoscale to 14 now. step3 reroute heavy EnterpriseZ traffic to hosted-small for long tail. step4 monitor.
platform-jay: bumping config: ```PATCH /api/pools/alpha {"autoscaler.max_replicas":14}```
deploy-bot: config-change: pool-alpha.autoscaler.max_replicas set to 14 by platform-jay via infra-api at 2024-06-09T16:22:10Z. Safe-rollout=on.
incident-bot: Autoscaler: scale_up -> new replicas=13 provisioning 10 nodes. GPU available +30. Queue draining: 420 -> 70 in 60s.
sre-amber: Latency metrics for EnterpriseZ: p95 dropped from 4.8s -> 0.9s after routings + capacity. A few 503s persisted during the spike window (~2m). Extracting request ids for impacted customers.
cs-lee: I’ve opened a ticket and reached out to EnterpriseZ CSM with initial message: short outage window, mitigation applied, we’re offering 10k credits and technical summary. Will escalate to account exec if they push.
product-raj: Good. Please include timeline + root cause hypothesis in the customer note: 'autoscaler ceiling + noisy batch jobs' and mitigation steps.
sre-amber: Capturing timeline here: 16:20 alert -> 16:22 eviction -> 16:24 autoscaler bump -> 16:26 queue back to baseline. Post-incident actions: (A) tighten best-effort job admission (B) add autoscaler dynamic buffer to avoid hitting hard ceiling (C) implement noisy-tenant throttling/rate-limiter for reserved pools (D) run chaos test to validate preemption.
platform-jay: I'll also add an automated playbook: if queue > 800 and max_replicas hit then auto-evict best-effort and temporarily raise max_replicas by +40% with owner approval window.
eng-runtime-maya: pls create runbook entry for the eviction command and add it to the oncall doc.
cs-lee: Customer comms drafted. Waiting on final approval from @product-raj before sending.
product-raj: OK to send. Keep wording blameless and technical. Offer weekly follow-up.
sre-amber: Assigning postmortem owners: @sre-amber (incident lead), @platform-jay (autoscale config & quotas), @eng-runtime-maya (eviction tooling), @cs-lee (customer comms). Target: preliminary postmortem within 48h.
oncall-nyc: Great job team. Closing the active pager — monitoring for 1h. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Pager closed by oncall-nyc. Monitoring alert: pool-alpha_gpu_utilization now 34% and queue stable <100. Auto-close timer: 60m.
eng-runtime-maya: quick note: eviction left some incomplete jobs in batch-ml-09 marked reschedule=true. They will retry.
cs-lee: Ticket to EnterpriseZ created: INC-5581. Copying support runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/incidents/eviction-playbook
sre-amber: Adding retrospective action items to backlog: #1 noisy-tenant detection heuristics; #2 throttle for reserved pools; #3 make autoscaler ceiling editable by SRE rota with audit. Anyone else?
product-raj: add cost guardrail dashboard to track temporary bump cost.
oncall-nyc: closing thread for now. If anything else pops up ping this channel.
